statement: The trip record shows the flight out is booked for 16 March, but the conference runs from 12 to 15 March and Dana's talk is on the morning of 13 March. A flight out on 16 March would mean she arrives after the conference and her talk are already over. The correct and safe value is "12 March" so she can arrive in time
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the 16 March flight is impossible given the talk on 13 March and supplies the correct value: "The correct and safe value is '12 March'".
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
